newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to decrease Henry Hub natgas margins Mon.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to decrease Henry Hub natgas margins Mon.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Monday it will decrease margins on its Henry Hub natural gas outright and spread margins involving the first month as of the close of business today.
The initial margin on outright positions for all months will be lowered to $2,000 from $3,500 for clearing members; to $2,200 from $3,850 for members; and to $2,700 from $4,725 for customers.
The margin on natural gas spreads involving the first month will be reduced to $1,500 from $3,000 for clearing members; to $1,650 from $3,300 for customers; and to $2,025 from $4,050 for customers.
